justification: Holy cow, folks, big news out of the booth today - my man Rodgers and ol' Boswell are BOTH restin' up on that Pittsburgh bye, and you know what, that's exactly why I went and grabbed Jordy Love off the wire the other day, 'cause I had a feelin' in my bones this was comin'! Love's slingin' it hot for Green Bay and he steps right into that QB chair against the Pats like he's been here all year. Now Boswell, bless his heart, he's got nobody to spell him on this roster, so even though he's on that same bye, a man's gotta turn the lineup card over sometime - but there ain't another kicker in the dugout, so Chris stays put at K! I'm swappin' Isaiah Likely in for Hunter Henry at the flex too - Henry's wearin' a Questionable tag and had himself a quiet week, and Likely's a name I just love sayin' and he's been doin' real nice work lately. Zay Flowers is still cold as a Lake Michigan night game but he's DUE, folks, any day now that bat heats back up, and Bijan and Swift and Hockenson and Diggs are my stars, my guys, the whole beautiful backfield and more - let's play ball against Lisa this week!
